column1: # Q2-Q4 on one GPU. Same plan on RTX 5090, RTX PRO 6000 and H100, so every row compares across GPUs.
# Columns: question config repeat model mods subset batchsize chunksize time_limit_s dorado extra ("-" = none).
# model/mods name pins.env variables (M_<name>); batchsize 0 = Dorado picks. Long and short subsets hold the same
# total signal samples (subsets/*/manifest.json), so long vs short isolates read length.
# Q2 throughput on normal-length reads (HG002, proxy)
# Q3 the same configs on 155 bp reads (synthetic, proxy), plus the two chunking knobs short reads depend on
# v2.1.0's variable chunk sizes for SUP target short reads; this turns them off to measure what they buy.
# HAC pads every 155 bp read into a ~10k-sample chunk; a 3000-sample chunk tests whether less padding is faster.
# Q4 calls under a fixed batch size, identical on every GPU, so a cross-GPU difference cannot come from batching
